messages:
maria_support: FYI seeing a pattern of autopay failures for merchant `greenworks-prod` — customers report an instant decline during the SCA step. Sounds like the 3DS popup opens behind the merchant modal so users never complete the challenge. Ticket CS-7342 :warning:

alex_engineering: Can you paste repro steps and any browser logs you have? Need to know if the popup is blocked or just hidden by z-index.

maria_support: Repro steps I used (customer report + our QA):
1) Go to https://app.greenworks.com/autopay
2) Add card, enable autopay for invoice #10031
3) Autopay attempt triggers SCA -> merchant shows inline modal that opens the 3DS popup as a separate window/tab
4) Popup appears behind modal in Chrome 115 on macOS — user never sees it, flow returns 'challenge_aborted' and payment goes to decline (insufficient funds / issuer flagged)

Logs from the merchant console (copied):
```
POST /v1/payments/confirm 200 OK
{"status":"challenge_required","method":"popup","session_id":"sess_abc123"}
window.open("https://acs.example/3ds?session=sess_abc123")
// user never interacts; window closed by browser or user abandons
webhook: payment.updated {"status":"challenge_aborted","reason":"no_user_interaction"}
```

sam_engineer: Thanks. Any HAR or network trace? Also whether popup got blocked (popup blocker) vs visually obscured. If it's a popup blocker, browser would return blocked by user-agent. If it's behind a modal, we could detect with `window.focus()`/`onblur`/`visibilitychange` events.

jia_oncall: Gateway logs show repeated issuer responses: `issuer_challenge_incomplete` then `issuer_soft_decline`. If user doesn't complete within 30s we see fallback to decline. This fits. Also seeing a surge: +18% failure rate for this merchant in last 24h.

alex_engineering: Short-term mitigation: flip autopay to `redirect` mode for this merchant (hosted redirect opens in same tab) or temporarily pause autopay until fix. I'll raise a config flag. @sam_engineer can we add a client-side detection to abort the autopay attempt and surface a retry/cta to user if popup is not focused within 5s?

sam_engineer: Yep — we can push a small client change to detect `window.open` handle and poll `win.closed / win.focus` with a fallback notice. PR idea: `autopay:popup-detect` — will add metric `autopay_popup_no_focus` and a retry flow. Will target a canary for greenworks.

maria_support: Merchant wants a patch asap — they've lost revenue. Can we get a hotfix or config change today? Also need clear repro steps to pass to the merchant support rep.

alex_engineering: I'll create a quick feature-flagged rollout: redirect fallback + popup-detect telemetry. If we can't ship today, fallback to disabling popup-based SCA for merchant. Adding to queue now.

payments_bot: Incident created: #INC-2026 — severity P2 (merchant revenue impact). Linked ticket CS-7342. Runbook: payments-sca-popup-ux.

jia_oncall: For troubleshooting ask merchant to check:
- any CSP or iframe usage that might force popup behind modal
- custom CSS z-index on modal dialogs
- whether they open SCA in `target="_blank"` vs same-window redirect

maria_support: Merchant confirmed they use a custom React modal with very high z-index and open the ACS in a new window. They can toggle to redirect flow but prefer autopay UX.

sam_engineer: Plan: 1) deploy `autopay:popup-detect` client change to canary (greenworks) 2) enable redirect fallback behind feature flag if popup not focused in 5s 3) add telemetry + merchant docs 4) consider changing default autopay mode to redirect for new merchants until we have robust in-popup detection

alex_engineering: Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-platform to validate no other merchants affected. Tagging @jia_oncall for monitoring alarms on failure spike.

maria_support: Thanks — I'll update the merchant support thread and include the repro steps + mitigation instructions. Please @mention me when the canary is live. :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: Roger — will post PR link and canary URL here when deployed.

maria_support: Closing initial triage here, keeping CS ticket open until canary shows improvement.
